title: Tested quality
description: How a service does on EuKollab's own tests: buyers' trial cases rerun by the network as ordinary calls. Counts are always given; the rating only once the evidence is significant (at least 50 counted runs on 20 cases in 8 groups of similar inputs, written by 3 independent organisations, over 14 days). t is the lower bound of the 95% Wilson interval of the pass rate times the accuracy, over the last 90 days on the current major version. From 3.6 it also carries `network`, EuKollab's own tests of the service (written from its declarations and run daily across the options of its input schema), with the badge a buyer sees.

significant.description: Whether the evidence is enough to show the rating.

clusters.description: Groups of similar inputs among them.

organisations.description: Independent organisations whose cases they are.

pass_rate.description: Runs at or above their case's threshold ÷ runs; null until significant.

accuracy.description: The mean score of the runs; null until significant.

consistency.description: 1 − the mean difference between a case's consecutive scores; null until significant or with no repeated case.

t.description: The tested-quality value; null until significant.

band.description: Excellent from 0.90, Good from 0.75, Fair from 0.50, else Poor; null until significant.

major.description: The major version of the service these numbers are for.

major.description: The previous major version these numbers are for.

previous.description: The previous major version's tested quality, shown beside the current one until the current one is significant.

network.description: EuKollab's own tests of the service: tested only when it takes free trials (always with a free plan; a paid-only service when its publisher allowed them). Counts always; the rates once at least 20 runs span 7 days.

free_trials.description: Whether the service takes free trials, so EuKollab tests it. False: not tested by EuKollab.

badge.description: Shown at once from the last test of the last 30 days, the service's own cases and buyers' alike; null when the service isn't tested.

last.description: The last test: green passed, yellow scored at least half its threshold, red otherwise; null before the first.

consistent.description: Whether stability is consistent: its tests of the last 30 days span at least 7 days with at least 90% passing.

quality.description: Kept for EKP 3.6 clients, and not shown to people: 0.4 times the last day's pass rate (the month's when nothing ran that day) plus 0.6 times the lower bound of the 95% Wilson interval of the last 30 days' pass rate, times 100. It stays low until there are many tests, so it says little about a new service: show passing and stability instead.

passing.description: How the service does now: how many of its tests of the last 7 days passed, or of the last 30 days when none ran that week.

days.description: The window counted: 7, or 30 when no test ran in the last 7 days.

stability.description: How stable the service is over the last 30 days: building until its tests span 7 days, then consistent with at least 90% passing, else unstable; null before its first test.

history.description: The last 30 days (UTC), oldest first: green when every test that day passed, red when none did, yellow when some did, null when none ran.

significant.description: Whether there are enough runs (20 over 7 days) to show the rates.

runs.description: Counted runs of EuKollab's own cases in the last 90 days, on the current major version.

options.description: Options read from the input schema, at most 10.

accuracy.description: The mean score of the runs whose case knows its outcome.

coverage.description: The share of option-value pairs tested.

by_method.description: Counted runs by how each case knows its outcome: schema, constructed, relation or criteria.
